title: Box plot
description: One box per column on a log scale: first to third quartile as a needle box, the median as a surface-coloured line across it, whiskers to the extremes; muted columns out of bounds. Focusing a column marks its high and low with a hairline across the plot and a chip on the column, so there is no tooltip.

anatomy.description: The root with data-slot="box-plot", role="img" and a summary of every column's count, range and median.
A group per box with --fill and --ink (needle-700 and needle-900, out of bounds when muted): hit rect, hover wash, whisker, box, median, label pill and label.
For the focused column, a hairline across the plot at its high and its low and a needle-pastel chip on the column naming each; the two chips step clear when the lines are close.

usage: Figures must be positive: the scale is logarithmic and clamps at 1. Use it for amounts that spread over orders of magnitude (contract values, attendance), not for rates.
countLabel names what count counts in the summary ('games', 'signings').
A column with count 0 shows its label alone; pass it rather than dropping the period, so the axis keeps its rhythm.
